C.domain: Subtraction of fractions and mixed numbers, including common denominators, unlike denominators, regrouping, normalization, and simplification

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when the denominators do not already match.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the same denominator before subtracting.
Tag for unlike-denominator fraction-only items and mixed-number items whose fractional parts have unlike denominators.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag steps that only subtract numerators after denominators already match.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number unless it also includes creating equivalent fractions to match denominators.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a shared denominator and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the forms are aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step subtracts numerators over a common denominator.
Tag when a step subtracts whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers separately.
Tag when a step subtracts after prior denominator matching or after rewriting a whole number as a mixed form with 0 fractional part.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding a common denominator or converting equivalent fractions.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that adjust the whole and fractional parts after a negative fractional result.
Do not tag final simplification-only or combine-only steps.

skills.name: Regroup or normalize
skills.definition: Rewrite quantities into workable forms by normalizing mixed numbers with improper fraction parts, expressing whole numbers as having 0 fractional parts, or borrowing 1 whole into fractional units during subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a mixed number with 0 over a denominator, such as 3 to 3 + 0/5.
Tag when 1 whole is borrowed from the whole part and converted into denominator-sized fractional units.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction steps that do not change the representation of a number.
Do not tag denominator matching by equivalent fractions unless the step also rewrites a whole or mixed number structure as described above.
Do not tag simplification of a final fraction.

skills.name: Simplify and express
skills.definition: Reduce the result to lowest terms and present it in an appropriate final form such as a fraction, mixed number, whole number, or zero.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is simplified to lowest terms.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0.
Tag when separate whole and fractional results are combined into the final mixed number or integer form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that produce an unsimplified intermediate result.
Do not tag denominator matching or borrowing steps.
Do not tag normalization steps unless they explicitly simplify or state the final expressed result.

A.domain: Subtraction of fractions and mixed numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize fraction forms
skills.definition: Rewrite fractional parts into a directly subtractable form by finding a common denominator or by normalizing an improper mixed-number fraction part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD/common denominator and converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions before subtracting.
Tag when the solution normalizes a mixed number whose fractional part is improper (for example, 2 3/2 to 3 1/2) before subtraction.
Tag when this rewriting is done to make the fractional parts comparable for subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion or normalization is performed.
Do not tag simple rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d; that belongs to decomposition for mixed/whole subtraction.
Do not tag the actual subtraction after forms are made compatible.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Carry out subtraction once quantities are aligned, including subtracting numerators of like fractions and subtracting whole parts and fraction parts separately in mixed-number problems.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts fractions with the same denominator by subtracting numerators.
Tag when the solution subtracts whole-number parts and fractional parts separately in a mixed-number or whole-number context.
Tag when the subtraction produces an intermediate negative fractional part before any borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is to create common denominators or normalize improper mixed numbers.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps used to fix a negative fractional result.
Do not tag simplification-only steps such as reducing 2/10 to 1/5 or 0/3 to 0.

skills.name: Regroup for subtraction
skills.definition: Borrow or decompose a whole into fractional units, including rewriting a whole number as a whole plus 0 over the denominator, so subtraction can continue when a fractional part is insufficient.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as n + 0/d to set up mixed-number subtraction.
Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it into d/d added to the fractional part.
Tag when regrouping is used because the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed-number fraction part such as 1 5/3 to 2 2/3; that is equalizing fraction forms.
Do not tag ordinary subtraction steps that do not involve decomposition or borrowing.
Do not tag final combining or simplification after regrouping is complete.

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the computed result to lowest terms and present it in an appropriate final form such as a fraction, mixed number, whole number, or zero.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution reduces a fraction such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when the solution simplifies a zero fraction such as 0/3 to 0.
Tag when the solution combines whole and fractional parts into the final mixed number or integer form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the subtraction computation itself.
Do not tag finding common denominators, normalization, or borrowing steps.
Do not tag intermediate unsimplified forms unless the step explicitly simplifies or states the final expressed result.

B.domain: Subtraction of fractions and mixed numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize fraction forms
skills.definition: Rewrite fractional parts into a compatible form for subtraction by finding a common denominator or by rewriting a whole number as a number with a fractional part of denominator 0/d.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD/common denominator and converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/d so its fractional part can be subtracted with another fraction or mixed number.
Tag when a fraction-only item is converted to equivalent fractions before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no rewriting is performed.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2; that belongs to S02.
Do not tag the actual subtraction step after forms are already aligned.

skills.name: Normalize mixed numbers
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number with an improper fractional part into an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution changes a form like 2 3/2 into 3 1/2.
Tag when the solver explicitly carries extra wholes out of an improper fractional part in a mixed number.
Tag whether the normalized mixed number appears as the minuend or subtrahend.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversions such as 3/5 to 6/10.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as 3 + 0/5; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping during subtraction; that belongs to S04.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Perform the subtraction once forms are compatible, either by subtracting numerators of like fractions or by subtracting whole parts and fractional parts separately.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts numerators of fractions with the same denominator.
Tag when the solution subtracts whole-number parts and fractional parts of mixed numbers separately.
Tag when the subtraction is completed without needing a borrow, even if the result is zero.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag preparatory rewriting or denominator conversion steps; those belong to S01 or S02.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after a negative fractional difference appears; that belongs to S04.
Do not tag simplification of the resulting fraction to lowest terms.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Resolve a negative fractional part by borrowing one whole into fractional units and reduce the resulting fraction or zero form to lowest terms before stating the final answer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to d/d to continue subtraction.
Tag when the solution simplifies a fraction such as 2/10 to 1/5, 9/12 to 3/4, or 0/3 to 0.
Tag when both regrouping and simplification occur in the same item.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag straightforward subtraction that does not require borrowing and does not include simplification.
Do not tag finding a common denominator or rewriting a whole as 0/d; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers; that belongs to S02.
